_meta.note: Paths in 'file' are relative to /Users/wal/projects/mod/.cache/assets. All sources are CC0 1.0. Kenney GLBs reference the shared palette texture in the Textures/ folder next to them (colormap.png for Food/Survival, variation-a.png for Blaster Kit). Poly Pizza model URLs are https://poly.pizza/m/<id>. 'materials' lists the material names found on import, which is where the recolor hints apply.
_meta.style: Render every model with the same Blender camera/lighting rig and the realistic material overrides below, so the mixed-source models look like one set.

energy_cell.pack: Poly Pizza / Dipper98 'Sci Fi Wall Power Cell'
energy_cell.author: Dipper98
energy_cell.recolor: 'Ground' -> dark gunmetal (#2a2d31, metallic 0.8, roughness 0.4); 'Blue' tubes -> emissive cyan #3cdcff, strength 4-6
energy_cell.notes: 10 meshes, a box housing with vertical glowing tubes. It is wall-mounted (flat back), so turn it 3/4 to the camera. It fits a 'sci-fi power cell' better than any battery model.

scrap_electronics.author: iPoly3D
scrap_electronics.recolor: 'Green' -> darker, dirtier PCB green #2f5a2a with grime/scorch; 'conduct' -> worn gold. Optional broken look: boolean-cut a jagged corner off the board, or tilt it and darken one edge as burnt
scrap_electronics.notes: A flat board with chips and a gold edge connector. Lay it diagonally across the icon.

weapon_parts.pack: Poly Pizza / Quaternius 'Collectible Gear' + 'Spring' + Kenney Blaster Kit
weapon_parts.author: Quaternius; Kenney
weapon_parts.recolor: everything gunmetal/steel (#3a3e44 to #8a9099, metallic 0.9); remove the spring's red cap (hide the 'Red' mesh, or paint it steel); give the clip a dark gunmetal body with no glow
weapon_parts.notes: No single CC0 'gun components' model was found. Build a small pile: gear lying flat at the back, clip-small angled across it, spring in front. Normalize the scales first (gear ~0.4u, spring ~2.8u, clip ~0.26u).

focusing_lens.author: MilkAndBanana
focusing_lens.recolor: remove the handle (delete the verts below the oval head) so only a framed oval lens is left; frame -> brushed steel/brass; glass -> transmissive glass with a faint blue tint and a bright specular highlight
focusing_lens.alt: blaster-kit/Models/GLB format/scope-small.glb (Kenney): use as a gunmetal optic with a glowing glass end if the cropped mirror reads badly at 32px
focusing_lens.notes: This is a hand mirror with a single material, so split the head from the handle by position. Scale is large (41u tall), so normalize it.

resonance_crystal.author: iPoly3D
resonance_crystal.recolor: violet #9a4dff, glassy (transmission 0.3, roughness 0.15) plus emission #b45aff at strength 2-3 so it glows
resonance_crystal.notes: Clustered spikes. It reads very well as a small icon.

battery.author: hat_my_guy
battery.recolor: keep the copper/orange top and black body; add slight metallic to the terminals
battery.notes: AA cell with a '+' marking. Render it at a tilt (about 30 degrees) so it fills the 32x32 square. No CC0 9V model was found.

cell_pack_small.author: Kenney
cell_pack_small.recolor: same repaint as the blasters: dark gunmetal body, with the toy-yellow strip -> emissive cyan #3cc8ff
cell_pack_small.notes: Use the same material remap as the blaster repaint so the ammo matches the guns.

cell_pack_standard.author: Kenney
cell_pack_standard.recolor: gunmetal body, glowing accent strip -> emissive cyan #3cc8ff

cell_pack_heavy.author: Kenney
cell_pack_heavy.recolor: gunmetal body with a hazard band; glow in orange-amber #ffb33c, or brighter cyan, so it reads as a different tier
cell_pack_heavy.compose: two clip-large side by side (bundled), or a single clip-large scaled 1.0 x 1.8 x 1.2 to make it wider and thicker
cell_pack_heavy.notes: The kit has no third clip size, so make the heavy pack from clip-large.

dampener.author: Kenney
dampener.recolor: matte black/gunmetal with a faint energy ring at the muzzle end
dampener.notes: Lay it diagonally across the icon.

bandage.author: Kenney
bandage.recolor: main roll -> off-white gauze #ece8dc (rough, fabric); straps -> pale tan or hidden. Shorten the length to about 0.6x so it reads as a gauze roll
bandage.notes: The closest CC0 roll shape found. The CC0 searches turned up no bandage model (Poly Pizza bandages are CC-BY).

antibiotics.author: Quaternius
antibiotics.recolor: body -> translucent amber pharmacy plastic #c8761e; cap -> white; label -> plain white with a thin blue/grey stripe. NO red cross
antibiotics.notes: Textured with an atlas, so recolor per atlas region or by face-material reassignment. It has a pill-bottle silhouette.

canned_food.author: Kenney
canned_food.recolor: more realistic tin: metallic lids/rims (steel); label -> muted faded colour; optional light dents/grime

bottled_water.author: Quaternius
bottled_water.recolor: 'Plastic' -> clear PET (transmission 0.9, light blue tint #d8f0ff), 'Grey' cap -> blue #2f7de0, 'Red' label -> light blue/white label
bottled_water.notes: A realistic ribbed PET bottle shape.

dirty_water.author: Kenney
dirty_water.recolor: glass -> green-brown translucent glass; contents -> murky brown-green #6b6a3a, low transmission; label -> torn/faded or hidden; cork -> dark

cloth.author: Isa Lousberg
cloth.recolor: replace the light blue with dirty beige/grey rag colour #9c8f78 and high roughness; optional fabric noise bump
cloth.notes: A folded towel. Recoloured and darkened it reads as a cloth rag.

duct_tape.author: darkrose
duct_tape.recolor: use tape.png, or override: outer -> silver-grey cloth tape #9aa0a6 (metallic 0.3, roughness 0.5), inner core -> cardboard brown
duct_tape.notes: Import the OBJ (do not open the .blend). The roll is flat (0.4 x 0.4 x 0.105), so render it at a 3/4 tilt to show the hole.

scrap_metal.author: Kenney
scrap_metal.recolor: rusty corrugated steel: base #7a4a2a rust blended with patches of grey steel #8a8f94, high roughness; screws dark steel
scrap_metal.notes: A corrugated sheet offcut with screws. Tilt it so the corrugation reads.

matches.author: Quaternius
matches.recolor: box -> cardboard/khaki, match heads -> red; mostly use as is
matches.notes: An upright box with match sticks poking out of the top. Clear silhouette.

lighter_fluid.author: Quaternius
lighter_fluid.recolor: paint the can yellow-orange #e0a020 with a black cap to signal lighter fluid (or keep it red for a jerry-can look); add slight metallic and wear
lighter_fluid.alt: https://poly.pizza/m/jRymgnHTTb (Quaternius Gas Can, red with white stripes, CC0, not downloaded)
lighter_fluid.notes: A jerry-can shape. Lighter fluid is normally a small squeeze can, but no CC0 model of one was found.
